question: Can the fusion Transformer be made to beat the linear reference on 6-class PAM50 subtyping and hold up on external validation?
verdict: No. The gap is bias-limited rather than optimization-limited, and the single intervention that raised internal CV lowered external accuracy.

reference.note: Reproduced exactly by the rebuilt harness on train-only 5-fold CV.

step2_diagnosis.conclusion: Bias-limited. Best capacity configuration reaches 69.84% (d128_l4), 5.4 points below the LogReg reference of 75.26%, and 11 of 12 cells fall in a 65.5-69.8% band, so capacity is not the binding constraint. The learning curve is still rising but flattens: +2.51, +1.77, +1.46 acc-points per 239 samples, an instantaneous slope of 0.43 acc-points per 100 samples at n=958. A log fit (acc = 39.6 + 4.10*ln n) projects 5,939 samples -- 6.2x the current training set -- just to reach LogReg parity, and 11,579 for 78%. No available cohort supplies that. The honest conclusion is that this architecture has a poorer inductive bias than a linear model on this 713-dimension, n=958 problem, so more aggressive regularization or pretraining is unlikely to close a 5-point gap.

step3_regularization.conclusion: No regularization axis closes the gap to the linear reference.

step4_pretraining.protocol: encoder pretrained per fold on that fold's training portion only (no leakage)
step4_pretraining.conclusion: Masked-feature pretraining is the only intervention that helps internally (+2.71 points).

step5_external_validation.conclusion: Best TCGA accuracy: logreg (73.76%). Pretraining improved METABRIC CV by 2.71 points but TCGA accuracy is 62.72% vs the linear reference 73.76% -- the CV gain does not transfer across platforms.

step6_treatment_outcome.caveat: Treatment fields are administered-treatment flags, not response assessments. This is prognosis among treated patients, not treatment-response prediction.
step6_treatment_outcome.conclusion: The 713-dimension panel out-discriminates a PAM50-subtype-only baseline in all three treated subgroups.

survival.risk_model: CoxPHFitter(penalizer=0.1) fit on METABRIC train, applied to GSE21653

step7_second_cohort.note: Genuine second external cohort with PAM50 labels and DFS endpoints; no claudin-low, basal-enriched (75/266).

step7b_multicohort_training.protocol: train on METABRIC(+GSE21653), evaluate on TCGA (n=987); mRNA-only, 369 common genes, per-platform rank normalization
step7b_multicohort_training.conclusion: Adding a second cohort (266 samples, +28%) raised the unguided Transformer by 1.11 points against a learning-curve prediction of +1.00 -- agreement within 0.11 points. The model is on exactly its extrapolated trajectory, confirming the bias-limited diagnosis: the remaining 7.6-point gap would still need roughly 6x more data to close.
